Calculate intrinsic growth rate, generation time, and steepness

Source: R/get_r.R
get_r.Rd

Calculate intrinsic growth rate for fishes using size, growth, maturity, and juvenile density-dependence traits

get_r(
  K,
  Winf,
  a_mat,
  CR,
  M,
  t0 = -0.1,
  a_slope = a_mat/4,
  d = 2/3,
  a_max = 100
)

Arguments

K

von Bertalanffy growth coefficient for length at age

Winf

Asymptotic maximum length

a_mat

age at maturity (in years)

CR

Compensation ratio, i.e., \(CR = 1 + MLER\) or \(CR = 1 + MAER / (1-exp(-M))\) where MLER and MAER are maximum lifetime and maximum annual excess replacement, respectively

M

Natural mortality rate (per year)

t0

Implied age with zero length

a_slope

slope of logistic maturity at age

d

Scaling of catabolism with length (specialized von Bertalanffy growth function assumes d = 2/3)

a_max

maximum age for computing life table

Examples

# Get traits for selected species
download_traits()
#> Downloading traits from Zenodo record 24259333 ...
#> Traits stored in /tmp/RtmpQ6DhtN/traits_2b38738de58c
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpQ6DhtN/traits_2b38738de58c"
traits = get_traits( "Lutjanus campechanus" )

# Extract growth rate
get_r(
  K = exp(traits$est['log(growth_coefficient)']),
  Winf = exp(traits$est['log(growth_coefficient)']),
  a_mat = exp(traits$est['log(age_maturity)']),
  MASPS = exp(traits$est['logMASPS']),
  M = exp(traits$est['log(natural_mortality)'])
)
#> Error in get_r(K = exp(traits$est["log(growth_coefficient)"]), Winf = exp(traits$est["log(growth_coefficient)"]),     a_mat = exp(traits$est["log(age_maturity)"]), MASPS = exp(traits$est["logMASPS"]),     M = exp(traits$est["log(natural_mortality)"])): unused argument (MASPS = exp(traits$est["logMASPS"]))

# Sample from predictive distribution
traits_i = mvtnorm::rmvnorm(
  n = 250,
  mean = traits$est,
  sigma = traits$cov
)
#> Error in UseMethod("isSymmetric"): no applicable method for 'isSymmetric' applied to an object of class "c('array', 'double', 'numeric')"

# Calculate and plot
pred_zi = mapply(
  FUN = get_r,
  K = exp(traits_i[,'log(growth_coefficient)']),
  Winf = exp(traits_i[,'log(growth_coefficient)']),
  a_mat = exp(traits_i[,'log(age_maturity)']),
  MASPS = exp(traits_i[,'logMASPS']),
  M = exp(traits_i[,'log(natural_mortality)'])
)
#> Error: object 'traits_i' not found
hist(pred_zi['intrinsic_growth_rate',])
#> Error: object 'pred_zi' not found
